messages.subject: Brookmere MSA - execution version for signature
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The execution version of the MSA is attached, reflecting the agreed 150% cap, 45-day payment terms, 90-day renewal notice and the clause 9.2 dataset wording. We propose signing in counterparts dated 23 January, with the Order Form (OF-2026-001) effective 1 February. Please arrange signatures for Daniel Okonkwo (Caspian) and Eleanor Whitford (Brookmere).

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Commercial
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
